{{Quote|We just lost the ''Dravilla''.|The [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] of the ''[[Extempus]]'', to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nezzor]]|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
The '''''Dravilla''''' was a [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was destroyed at the [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|Battle of Duro]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
